slice: Python's static typing system (typing module, annotations, generics, protocols, type checkers)
source: https://github.com/python/peps (raw .rst); titles/statuses cross-checked against https://peps.python.org/topic/typing/ on 2026-10-06
selection_notes: All 28 suggested candidates plus two non-accepted typing PEPs (677 Rejected, 724 Withdrawn) so the reasoner has real negative precedents. PEP 749 (Implementing PEP 649) is referenced via Superseded-By but kept out of scope; it will appear as an out-of-slice stub node.

peps.title: The Theory of Type Hints
peps.why_included: Informational foundation: defines gradual typing, consistency and subtyping vocabulary that later PEPs build on.

peps.title: Type Hints
peps.why_included: The root of the slice: introduces the typing module, Union/Optional, generics, TypeVar and the type-checker contract. Most other PEPs reference it.

peps.title: Syntax for Variable Annotations
peps.why_included: Adds variable annotation syntax (x: int) and ClassVar; the syntactic basis for TypedDict, dataclasses and Final.

peps.title: Protocols: Structural subtyping (static duck typing)
peps.why_included: Protocols / structural subtyping; key example of a design choice (static duck typing vs nominal ABCs) with rich rejected ideas.

peps.title: Distributing and Packaging Type Information
peps.why_included: How type information is shipped (py.typed, stub-only packages); links the type system to type checkers and packaging.

peps.title: Postponed Evaluation of Annotations
peps.why_included: Postponed evaluation (from __future__ import annotations). Superseded, so it exercises the SUPERSEDES relationship.

peps.title: Type Hinting Generics In Standard Collections
peps.why_included: Lets list[int], dict[str, int] replace typing.List/Dict; a 'why does Python do X' anchor for deprecated aliases.

peps.title: Literal Types
peps.why_included: Literal types; extended later by LiteralString (675) and used by TypedDict keys.

peps.title: TypedDict: Type Hints for Dictionaries with a Fixed Set of Keys
peps.why_included: TypedDict; parent of a family (655, 692, 705) and the natural target for 'typed dict literal' proposals.

peps.title: Adding a final qualifier to typing
peps.why_included: Final qualifier / @final; illustrates qualifiers alongside ClassVar and ReadOnly.

peps.title: Flexible function and variable annotations
peps.why_included: Annotated[T, x]: metadata in annotations; shows how non-typing uses of annotations were accommodated.

peps.title: Allow writing union types as X | Y
peps.why_included: X | Y union syntax; the canonical 'why X | Y instead of Union[X, Y]' question.

peps.title: Parameter Specification Variables
peps.why_included: ParamSpec and Concatenate for decorators/higher-order callables; relevant to callable typing.

peps.title: Explicit Type Aliases
peps.why_included: Explicit TypeAlias; later superseded in practice by the type statement in PEP 695.

peps.title: Variadic Generics
peps.why_included: TypeVarTuple / variadic generics (*Ts); extends the generics family.

peps.title: User-Defined Type Guards
peps.why_included: TypeGuard for user-defined narrowing; parent of the withdrawn 724 and the accepted 742.

peps.title: Deferred Evaluation Of Annotations Using Descriptors
peps.why_included: Deferred evaluation of annotations via descriptors; formally replaces PEP 563.

peps.title: Marking individual TypedDict items as required or potentially-missing
peps.why_included: Required[] / NotRequired[] for TypedDict items; part of the TypedDict family.

peps.title: Self Type
peps.why_included: Self type; common ergonomic feature that builds on TypeVar-bound patterns from 484.

peps.title: Arbitrary Literal String Type
peps.why_included: LiteralString; a security-motivated extension of Literal types (586).

peps.title: Callable Type Syntax
peps.why_included: Callable type syntax ((int) -> str). REJECTED; gives the reasoner a real 'this was rejected before' precedent.

peps.title: Data Class Transforms
peps.why_included: dataclass_transform; ties the type system to third-party libraries and type-checker behaviour.

peps.title: Using TypedDict for more precise **kwargs typing
peps.why_included: Unpack[TypedDict] for precise **kwargs; connects TypedDict to callable signatures.

peps.title: Type Parameter Syntax
peps.why_included: Type parameter syntax (class C[T], def f[T], type X = ...); modern generics syntax that reworks 484/613 patterns.

peps.title: Type Defaults for Type Parameters
peps.why_included: Defaults for type parameters; builds directly on 695 and TypeVar/ParamSpec/TypeVarTuple.

peps.title: Override Decorator for Static Typing
peps.why_included: @override decorator; an example of a checker-only marker in typing.

peps.title: Marking deprecations using the type system
peps.why_included: @deprecated in the type system; recent, small PEP that references many earlier ones.

peps.title: TypedDict: Read-only items
peps.why_included: ReadOnly TypedDict items; latest member of the TypedDict family.

peps.title: Stricter Type Guards
peps.why_included: Stricter type guards. WITHDRAWN in favour of 742; a second negative precedent for the reasoner.

peps.title: Narrowing types with TypeIs
peps.why_included: TypeIs narrowing; replaces 724 and refines 647, closing a three-PEP narrowing lineage.
